title: Fault line
description: A fractured stone surface opens into a vivid mineral field.
useCase: Reveal an unexpected colour or alternate material through a single deliberate action.
reducedMotion: Live reduced-motion preferences remove interpolation and decorative playback. All content and native controls remain available. Keyboard changes settle immediately.
limitations: Original demonstration content; adapt labels and state to the host product.
look: Dark slate surface split into seven angular charcoal shards, with acid-lime and teal mineral stripes glinting through thin cracks and a small outlined button.
motion: Pressing pushes seven clip-path shards apart, rotating them and shrinking to 0.8 over 0.7 s ease-out with a 25 ms stagger, exposing the striped mineral; pressing again reassembles them.
adapt: Shard outlines are the `pieces` polygon strings; the open pose is each shard's inline `transform` (index-based offsets, `(i - 3) * 8` degree rotation, `scale(.8)`) staggered by `transitionDelay` and eased by `.7s cubic-bezier(.22,.8,.2,1)`. Replace `.mineral` with the content to reveal.
